variants.label: Button
variants.tooltip: A standard button component commonly used for navigation and control.

variants.label: Primary
variants.tooltip: A standard button component commonly used for navigation and control.

variants.label: Secondary
variants.tooltip: A standard button component commonly used for navigation and control.

textStyle.description: Style properties that are applied to the text within the button.

primary.description: Toggle between the default primary and secondary button style.

image.description: An optional image to be embedded in the button

source.description: The image source URI. Could be a URL to an image on the internet or gateway, or could be an embedded image.

width.description: The width of the button image in pixels

height.description: The height of the button image in pixels

position.description: The position of the image within the button relative to the text

style.description: Style properties that are applied to the image within the button.

align.description: Align text and image (if present) along the cross axis. Vertical if imagePosition top or bottom, else horizontal.

justify.description: Justify text and image (if present) along the main axis. Horizontal if imagePosition top or bottom, else vertical.

events.name: onActionPerformed
events.description: This event is fired when the 'action' of the component occurs.
